subject.title: fix(codex): fail closed on unknown projector events

question: Should the maintainer-authored current head receive a proof override, or should the PR first provide refreshed terminal evidence for its new warn-and-continue behavior?
rationale: The existing proof is substantive but asserts the opposite projection result from the current head, so automation cannot treat it as exact-head behavior proof without an explicit override or refresh.

options.title: Refresh current-head proof
options.body: Update the PR description and run the standalone projector harness against the current head, showing unknown statuses remain completed while each diagnostic warns once.

options.title: Grant a proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused tests and direct branch rewrite as sufficient evidence without requesting another contributor transcript.

recommendation.title: Refresh current-head proof
recommendation.body: Update the PR description and run the standalone projector harness against the current head, showing unknown statuses remain completed while each diagnostic warns once.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current behavior change and is best positioned to decide whether its focused tests warrant a proof override.
